seats.description: Developers, owners included, plus pending team invitations.

app_users.description: App users across every app of the org, plus pending app-user invitations.

live_video_ms_per_month.description: Live video watched by app users in one UTC calendar month, in milliseconds, across the org. Console sessions do not count.

asset_bytes_per_robot.description: Asset storage per robot, in bytes (decimal: 1 GB = 1,000,000,000). The org stores up to robots × this value in total.

history_days.description: Days the org's robot history is kept.

audit_days.description: Days the org's audit log is kept.

collection_records.description: Records in the app collections of all the org's apps, together. Only current records count, deleted ones and the history do not. A write or an import that would add records past it is refused `409 plan_limit` naming this key; reads continue.

collection_bytes.description: Bytes the current records of all the org's app collections occupy, as stored JSON (decimal: 1 GB = 1,000,000,000). The history is shown beside it and not limited. A write or an import that would add data past it is refused `409 plan_limit` naming this key; reads continue.
